build.//: Built from the REPO ROOT, not apps/backend. npm workspaces hoist dependencies to the root node_modules, so building from the subdirectory would not resolve them.

deploy.//: `medusa build` emits a STANDALONE app into apps/backend/.medusa/server with its own package.json — that directory is what runs in production. Starting from apps/backend fails with 'Could not find index.html in the admin build directory'. It needs no separate npm install here: Node resolves up to the hoisted root node_modules.
deploy.//preDeploy: Migrations run before the new container takes traffic, so a failed migration cannot half-start the app.
